s: OpenTelemetry-native trace backend assembling cross-service waterfalls so latency mysteries get solved.
w: Apps emit spans (OTLP) describing operations with parent-child context propagation (trace ids ride headers). Collectors buffer/process/sample then store; query layer reconstructs full request journeys. Tail-based sampling keeps interesting traces (errors/slow) while dropping boring ones. Service maps derive dependency graphs automatically.
use: Finding which of 14 microservices adds 800ms p99
Post-incident journey reconstruction for specific failed requests
Dependency mapping discovery in grown-up microservice estates
avoid: Full capture forever (sampling essential - storage economics)
pits: Head sampling misses rare-but-weird traces - tail sampling based on latency/error attributes
tips: Context-propagation explanation (traceparent headers) shows real understanding
